done_when: On Forge's own repo, forge next finishes in under 5 seconds and forge doctor in under 30 seconds on a warm run, with the same output as before; next reads merge history with one git log call and reuses the board's snapshot, and doctor reads its pull requests in one or a few batched requests; before and after times are in the pull request; new and existing repos get it on upgrade
why: forge next takes about 25 seconds and forge doctor about 2.5 minutes on Forge's own repo: next makes about 600 git calls, most asking per item when it merged (story.completed and merged_at, the board numbers line), and doctor makes about 90 GitHub requests, one per merged pull request (doctor._prs) plus 4 slow ones for the CI time warning
